purpose: Test a receding-horizon water-value dispatcher before using it for future solar counterfactuals.

method.forecast_information: Perfect knowledge of historical inflows and dispatchable requirement only within the rolling horizon.
method.terminal_storage_target: Historical day-of-year median storage excluding the 2024 validation year.
method.terminal_target_type: Soft target; shortfall is allowed at a penalty rather than enforced as a hard minimum.
method.terminal_shortfall_cost: Source downstream MWh-per-Mm3 multiplied by terminal_water_value_factor per missing Mm3.
method.daily_storage_guard: None. Storage decisions are made by the rolling LP subject to reservoir floors/ceilings and route capacities.

important_limitations: This is still a simplified three-source upper-Waitaki routing model; Ruataniwha, Benmore and Aviemore are not independent storage decision nodes.
The LP sees perfect inflow and load information inside each rolling horizon, so it is an optimistic operational benchmark rather than a reconstruction of operator behaviour.
The terminal reserve target is historical climatology, not a calibrated market water-value curve.
Travel time, intra-day dispatch and lower-catchment tributary additions are still omitted.
